about.intro: Six years shipping React applications to production. I've led teams, debugged memory leaks at 3am, and refactored codebases that outlived their original authors.
paragraphs: I specialize in building full-stack applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. My work spans from trading platforms and AI-integrated products to real estate tools and e-commerce systems.

I care about performance, accessibility, and code that other developers can maintain. I've worked across blockchain (Solidity), backend (NestJS, Express), and frontend — but React is where I do my best work.
Currently based in the Netherlands, available for freelance projects and consulting engagements.
